summary: Ziff Davis, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the completion of the sale of its Connectivity division to Accenture Inc. for $1.2 billion in cash. The transaction closed on June 17, 2026, per a Securities Purchase Agreement dated March 2, 2026. The company also obtained lender consent via a Consent Agreement to its existing credit facility. Certain subsidiaries were designated as unrestricted subsidiaries under the 4.625% Senior Notes due 2030 indenture. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for use of proceeds and potential debt paydown or capital return. Risk-arb angle: closed deal; no further arbitrage opportunity.
